description: Apply Renovate's built-in config migrations (deprecated key renames, template-variable rewrites, packageRules consolidation, host-rules unification, etc.) to a config and return the migrated result. Pass either configPath (file on disk, JSON or JSON5) or configContent (inline JSON object). Returns { isMigrated, migrated, diff }. Does not write — chain with write_config to persist. First call has higher latency than other tools (Renovate's migration library cold-loads in a worker thread).

configPath.description: Absolute path to a config file to migrate

name: migrate_config
title: Migrate Renovate config to current schema
